entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whoa, this shit's real high up...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But at least we're outside! Is there a way[n]down out here!?
entries.uk: Але ми принаймні надворі![n]Чи є тут якийсь шлях униз?!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Is this another portal to an unknown[n]destination?
entries.uk: Це ще один портал у невідомість?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We don't have time to lose. Just go[n]through it! Now's our chance!
entries.uk: Нам не можна гаяти час. Просто[n]проходь крізь нього! Це наш шанс!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real!? But... I guess there's no[n]other way!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We do not have the time to head back[n]inside.
